reserveReview.rationale: Chronicle's independently verified holdings table identifies all 60 positions as of 2026-07-23: one $28.03 million PGIM AAA CLO ETF position and 59 individually identified CLO tranches, totaling $376.28 million of portfolio market value. The static reserve view aggregates those uniformly high-risk public-credit positions into one scoring bucket; the Chronicle source preserves every position identity, value, and disclosed maturity.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Chronicle Proof of Asset position-level market values
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No unidentified position remains in the dated holdings table. Disclosed maturities cover 92.55% of market value and span 3,836 to 5,473 days from the source date; the 7.45% PGIM AAA CLO ETF position has no stated maturity. Chronicle reports $376.28 million of gross holdings against $353.79 million NAV, retained as a 1.0636 gross-holdings-to-NAV reference rather than a contractual collateralization ratio.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The fund documentation names BNY as custodian and BNY Investments as sub-advisor for the BVI private fund holding the CLO portfolio, a structure that holds fund assets apart from Securitize's own balance sheet. Account-level segregation terms, rehypothecation restrictions, and custody of any interim cash balances are not publicly reproduced.
